_note: Assumed inputs, schemas and frozen parameters for 7.2. Paths are {key: path_for key, rel: relative}. Build agent, 2026-11-05. Edit freely. Parameters marked prereg are frozen after the S1 replay and before S2.

oof_prob.note: historical CV5 out-of-fold rasters. Replay pool source until the P1 isolated pit model exists

discovery_extra_blocks.schema: block_id int (unique across areas), area str, geometry. Warren non-reserved and one other D20 window

split._buffer_note: derived buffer comes from P1 S4. 0 until then, stated in every run

cost_minutes._note: VERIFY. Time one real block and 20 candidates before use (protocol section 13)

_G_note: User decision, set before scoring (here or in the preregistration JSON, key G). Null gives an inconclusive decision. G is never chosen from the replay it judges and never floored. G_raw (R recall at the budget minus at 75% of it) is reported as a diagnostic only (review 7.2-01, 2026-11-06)
_seed_note: User decision (review 7.2-02). Block ids whose base labels train every arm in the live retrain (the round-0 seed set). Null refuses the retrain. [] means acquired labels only

scoring._note: cutoff, min area, IoU and matching come from ek.policy_for(task) via sc.load_policy (F02, 2026-11-06). The old thr 0.10 is gone. k_per_km2 is kept for pooled recall and equals the policy value

_trainer_note: Command template for the live retrain. Placeholders {labels} {weights} {out} {init}. Null until the P1 isolated pit trainer exists
